# mimecast_dmarc_delegated_domain (Resource)

Manage DNS delegation for a Mimecast DMARC Analyzer managed domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_dmarc_delegated_domain" "example" {
  managed_domain_id = mimecast_dmarc_managed_domain.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `managed_domain_id` (String) Managed-domain ID to delegate.

### Read-Only

- `details` (String) Additional delegation details.
- `dkim_delegation_status` (String) DKIM delegation status.
- `dmarc_delegation_status` (String) DMARC delegation status.
- `dmarc_policy` (String) Delegated-domain DMARC policy.
- `domain` (String) Delegated domain hostname.
- `hash` (String) Short identifier used in delegation records.
- `id` (String) Delegated-domain ID. Mimecast uses the managed-domain ID.
- `spf_delegation_status` (String) SPF delegation status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_dmarc_delegated_domain.example managed-domain-id
```
